text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I did it! I got first place!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting closer—another step<n>forward in
perfecting the winning<n>equation!
choice_data_list: Gotta keep your eye on the prize, though.

text_block_list.text:
I'm getting closer—another step<n>forward in
perfecting the winning<n>equation!
choice_data_list: Gotta keep your eye on the prize, though.
Gotta keep your eye on the prize, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Really, though, I should also<n>be
congratulating you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This victory belongs to the both of us.<n>We're
chasing this dream together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I plan to prove the superiority of my<n>logical
approach in the next race too!<n>After which...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We'll celebrate our victory together<n>once more!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, I suppose I mustn't get carried<n>away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pride comes before the fall, as they<n>say. One should
always take stock of<n>what mistakes were made
and learn<n>for the next time around.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
On that note... Were there any errors<n>with my
opening... or my last spurt? I<n>feel like I could spend
all day combing<n>through my performance.
choice_data_list: Why don't we review it together real quick?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! And thank you for making<n>sure I don't rest
on my laurels.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to have you in my corner.
